start: ^Are you Wu Lingling? I will start my inquiry about the party and the Kalaviṅka, tell only the truth and do not hide anything.
^Do you confess about killing He Renshu?
^……Yes. I thought about it, if there is a second chance, will I make the same decision?
^Although my fingers still quiver when I think about killing people……But if I do not kill her, our lives will be harder and harder.
Node0: ^I did not think much, I saw Man Lu died in front of me, and I want to give back the pain, the grievance that our troupe had, so I took the things next to my hand and threw it at her.
^As a result, her reaction was intense, and in a moment she collapsed, panting weakly……Now to think about it, it might be allergies, or some other disease……

^It's not easy to have that opportunity, usually we don't have the opportunity to make contact with Miss He alone, only when she is planning something. Every time the troupe is attacked, she doesn't even know where the malice comes from...... It's almost impossible to have a fair fight, let alone have the upper hand like I did at the time.
^When she was breathing roughly, did you find something useful?
^<color=red>（I remember there is an evidence to prove it.）</color>
Evidence0: ^Yes…At that time my mind was very clear, I only want her to die. Maybe there is a better way to solve the problem……But I am not that smart, all I could think of, was an eye for an eye, simple like that.
^……Besides, just like the flowers given by my fans, there is endless love on the surface, but they can kill me for some reason I couldn't understand……I really don't understand.
^Right or wrong, how to judge? Do as I want, at least I won't regret it……
^Do you have anything that you can't let go?
^……I have a humble request, I do not have anything I miss in the world, only……When I died I seemed to see Wu. Is he ……okay?
^After I realized my love for him, I haven't tell him yet……Now he and I are seprated between life and death, if he know my feelings he might be troubled……
^Be seprated like this, all these years he tried to protact me, and at last I will think for him.
^Black and White Spirit Wardens, take Yue Ling to the Hometown-looking Platform.

^In the living world, there is no one on the street in the evening? Even the carriages are so few, far less prosperous than our netherworld……It looks so quiet, ah, is it snowing? It looks like it's early winter……You see, there is a small crack in the door there, it's Jin Wu!
^……His hair is longer, but he looks well.
^Yes, on such a cold day, he only wore a thin cotton gown over his long shirt, and it seemed that he was recovering well!
^Recovering? Ah, that is?!…It's, our agreement when we were young…
^……, It seems that he can live his life well, I no longer worry, thank you both.
^I will judge you according to your crimes, do you have any objections?
^No, I confess, thank you about granting my wishes, Lord.
HasProblem: ^Uhm……It's not the correct evidence, I need to think more carefully.
